overview:
The **Assault on Starkiller Base Trench** (34 ABY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Cold War**, fought on or above **Starkiller Base**. Resistance x-wings diving through starkiller base thermal oscillator trenches while han solo's strike team plants charges inside icy corridors.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Cold War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Assault on Starkiller Base Trench within the broader **Cold War** campaign. Front-line reports describe resistance x-wings diving through starkiller base thermal oscillator trenches while han solo's strike team plants charges inside icy corridors.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **34 ABY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Cold War.
significance: The Assault on Starkiller Base Trench illustrates how the Cold War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
